items.title: Fall Asleep with the Lighthouse Keepers | 47 Min Sleep Story (Sea & Lamplight)
items.description:
Spend a long, calm night with the lighthouse keepers of the Scottish coast in the 1860s. Climb the spiral stair at lighting-up time, sit beside the great glass lens as it slowly turns, keep the first watch with a pot of tea and the logbook, and watch a little schooner pass safely by a granite tower far out at sea.

Slow narration, soft sea sounds and a long ambient tail at the end, so you can let go whenever you are ready.
